neutral_component_scope: Start with write_batch-named implementation/public/internal headers and its matching test filename. db_impl-named files are bounded caller leads only; no storage-wide property is proposed.

scope_limits.closure: Use only bounded relevant windows of db_impl leads after relationships are confirmed. Persistence, recovery, environment and concurrent-system claims require separate closure.

goal: Later bounded source-grounded verification/specification assessment of this filename-defined storage-library slice; actionable handoff or no-new-work without predetermined properties.
adoption: Read-only planning only; no target production changes or execution without separate actual owner grants and applicable isolation.

license_locators: LICENSE copyright paragraph, three redistribution conditions and disclaimer
provenance.license_interpretation: Primary API BSD-3-Clause identification agrees with inspected root license text. Dependencies and per-file exceptions were not inspected.

uncertainties: Semantic version, dependencies, submodule identities and configuration behavior unexamined.
Immediate caller relationships, concurrency, storage-system boundaries, C FFI and deployment applicability unexamined.
Repository metadata and a narrow slice do not establish durability, recovery or correctness.
Catalog membership and assessment outcome unexamined.
identity_basis: Pinned Git commit/tree plus independently clean working tree and tracked object inventory; not a SHA-256 digest of every working-tree file
